verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a TypeScript agent framework with a CLI and Studio, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to disable vendor telemetry or usage tracking. The observability features (traces, tracking latency and cost) instrument the user's own agents; they are not a telemetry opt-out control and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
